newsitem.title: USA: Soros group holds 7.22 pct Amati Communications stake.
newsitem.headline: Soros group holds 7.22 pct Amati Communications stake.

text.p: A group including international financier George Soros said Wednesday it holds the equivalent of a 7.22 percent stake or 1.28 million common shares in Amati Communications Corp.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said investment partnerships controlled by Soros and Purnendu Chatterjee, an investment manager who is Soros' partner in a number of investments, agreed to buy, at a 15 percent discount from market price, shares of Amati for $15 million.
The group said it holds the stake for investment purposes.
Amati, based in San Jose, Calif., develops advanced telecommunications transmission equipment.
